jobs.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

Are you looking for a new challenging role where you can have a positive impact on digital transformation journey's ?

Join Capgemini as a SAP Solution Architect, and establish a long term relationship with our major customer, helping them optimizing their SAP transformation journeys.

 

CONTEXT

• As an End to End Solution Architect within Capgemini, your role is to help our clients in crafting, modelling and delivering a working end to end solution within one or more business domains.
• As a solution architect, you are involved in all aspects of an SAP project. During the design phase, you take the lead in creating a vision and a high-level solution, as a playing field for the different functional teams. During the build phase, you closely align with the technical architects to deliver a working solution, while monitoring the functional teams so that everyone adheres to the overall vision and solution. During the prep of the Go Live and the Go Live itself, you take the lead in guiding the client towards a successful transition and a smooth start-up.
• You work in tandem with the project manager, in a joint responsibility for the success of the project in scope, timeline and budget. You provide tactical input towards the steering committee, the delivery manager and the account manager. As part of the core team for a project or customer, you are the face of Capgemini and try to defend our interests, while delivering according to client expectations.
• Your role is to drive excellence for our clients through innovative (standard) SAP solutions crafting and strategic leadership and vision, optimizing performance and processes for sustainable business success.
 

YOUR ROLE

• Solution Design: collaborate with cross-functional teams to craft, design and implement a new and effective SAP-based solution that aligns with business objectives and best practices, based on SAP’s on-premise and cloud portfolio of solutions.
• Project Leadership: work closely together with the project manager and lead the functional teams, overseeing the entire project lifecycle from a solution and delivery perspective, ensuring high quality delivery according to client expectations, but also timely and within budget.
• System Configuration: keep in touch with the system and the latest SAP solutions and toolsets, in order to support our functional teams to configure and customize SAP to meet specific organizational requirements, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and processes in or out of SAP; while sticking as close as possible to the standard of SAP
• Team Management: manage and mentor consultants of various levels of expertise; providing guidance, training, and support to enhance their skills and contribute to project success
• Internal management and contributions: As a senior colleague within Capgemini, you actively follow the latest developments, roadmaps, toolsets and strategic visions of SAP, and you actively share your findings within the Architecture Community and beyond.

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of SAP project experience in a line of business, a sector or a solution suite, with proven knowledge in a SAP solution design and solution architect role
• Extensive knowledge of the latest SAP technology portfolio, on-premise, in the cloud (BTP, CALM,...) and ecosystem for your domain of expertise, and how to apply them in a clean core approach
• Knowledge of common non-SAP technologies that are used your domain of expertise, such as : GIS, Copperleaf, IoT, Field Service Management, transport management solutions, ServiceNow, integration platforms, automated warehouse management solutions, …
• A collaborative spirit & customer-oriented attitude, being able to lead both internally and externally
• Result-driven & focused on delivering quality, within the boundaries of a project and a contract
• Fluency in Dutch or French is mandatory and professional working proficiency in English

jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems
jobs.description:
1 Software Engineer (m/f/d) ¿ Lifestyle Check & Wellabe Lab Systems Your mission
Ownership Lifestyle Check - lab systems 

 * Taking over and owning the on-site Windows service that bridges our medical measurement devices to the platform. It drives around 10 device families via Bluetooth, serial, TCP and file exchange. 
 * Operation, maintenance and further development of the device drivers, the local REST API, the system-tray status UI, firmware updates and the Windows installer. 
 * Building and shipping releases: PyInstaller executable, NSIS installer, Windows Defender/firewall handling, auto-update mechanism and the PT10 ESP32 firmware flasher. 
 * Rolling out releases to the lab sites and troubleshooting problems that occur on-site - including occasional travel to our locations. 
 * Securing and documenting the systems so they can be maintained by more than one person in the long run. 

Lab operator frontend and backend

 * Owning the lab operator web app, an Angular / Ionic / Electron application that runs on the lab PC and guides the operator through login, packages, stations, appointments and the checkup flow. 
 * Maintaining and improving the Capacitor/Electron build and the GitHub Actions release pipeline. 
 * Owning the device configuration backend, a Django REST backend that stores lab and device configuration, authenticates lab operators, generates signed Google Cloud Storage URLs and receives logs from the field. 
 * Keeping the REST APIs, PostgreSQL models, authentication bridge and upload pipeline secure and reliable.

Product-wide improvements and integrations

 * Driving refactoring, dependency updates and reliability improvements across the Lifestyle Check stack. 
 * Integrating with the wider Wellabe platform: the Laravel/PHP admin platform for device master data, the Flask backend that handles body-age calculations and reporting, and the Ionic/Capacitor mobile app for user-facing results. 
 * Improving observability: centralised logging, clearer error signals and faster remote diagnosis so that "it didn't work in Munich on Tuesday" becomes solvable from your desk. 
 * Maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release workflows.

Data quality & collaboration

 * Quality and robustness ownership - you design and maintain solutions that are reliable, fit our business needs and are reasonably easy to operate and maintain. 
 * Careful handling of health data - data protection and security are not a formality here. 
 * Collaboration with our development team.

Your profile
Must-haves

 * Strong Python skills - you can find your way into unfamiliar, grown code and own both Flask and Django backends. 
 * Experience with hardware integration - serial interfaces, Bluetooth, TCP; you can read a device protocol and understand what is happening on the wire. 
 * Frontend skills - solid Angular/TypeScript experience and a practical understanding of Ionic/Capacitor or Electron build chains. 
 * Strong SQL and experience with relational databases (we use PostgreSQL and SQLite). 
 * Remote debugging from incomplete information - you can reconstruct what happened from logs, screenshots and second-hand descriptions, without being able to reproduce the issue locally. 
 * Willingness to travel to our offices in Munich and Vienna, and enjoyment of working with real devices. 
 * Fluent German - you need to communicate with local teams and support staff at our lab sites in German-speaking countries. 
 * Good English - collaboration in an international team.

Nice-to-haves

 * Windows engineering - services, packaging, installers, firewall; our application runs unattended on the on-site PCs. 
 * PyInstaller + NSIS experience, or comparable desktop-deployment tooling. 
 * PHP / Laravel basics so you can read and coordinate changes in our admin platform. 
 * Security awareness - patching, handling secrets, dependency management, GDPR in a health context.

1 Senior Consultant (Mid-Level) - Focus Product Management (m/f/d) / Product Owner Tasks
As a Senior Consultant focused on product management at Trinsik, you own digital products end-to-end - from blank page to live, growing product. In our venture-building teams, you turn client and user needs into a clear product vision, validate fast, and lead cross-functional teams to ship.

What You'll Do
 * Define the vision, strategy and roadmap for new digital products, aligned with client business goals and validated against real user needs
 * Take products from scratch - frame the problem, shape the proposition, and validate before scaling; create new propositions, not just improve existing ones
 * Lead product discovery with user research, analytics, benchmarking and hypothesis validation; size opportunities quantitatively
 * Prioritize the backlog by customer value, business impact and technical feasibility, using clear frameworks
 * Lead agile teams across engineering, UX/UI, data and QA, coordinating with marketing, sales and operations for launch
 * Define success metrics, track them, and run an evidence-based cycle of experimentation, learning and iteration
 * Use generative AI and agents to accelerate definition, validation and prototyping - AI as part of how you work
 * Contribute to commercial outcomes - help ship revenue-generating propositions and deliver against targets

Requirements
 * Hands-on experience across the full digital product lifecycle - discovery, definition, delivery and measurement
 * Exposure to 0-to-1 work: you've helped create and validate new products or features, not only maintained existing roadmaps
 * 3-5 years in product management / product ownership for digital products
 * Commercially minded - you've worked to clear targets and are keen to own a number
 * Data-literate: fluent with product analytics, A/B testing and funnel/CRO optimization; you use data as evidence
 * A clear writer - your documents move discussions forward and help teams decide
 * High agency and comfort with ambiguity: you set your own priorities and move without waiting for a perfect brief
 * Strong stakeholder management with senior stakeholders and clients, written and verbal, in German and English
 * A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
 * Experience in venture building, startups, or innovation consulting
 * Technical fluency to dialogue with engineering (APIs, web/mobile architectures)
 * Product marketing or positioning background
 * Solid command of agile methods (Scrum, Kanban) and prioritization frameworks (RICE, MoSCoW, ...)

Benefits
The Numbers: €60,000 - €70,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible hours and home office to balance life while keeping a vibrant team dynamic.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere in the EU, up to 20 calendar days/year, or use sabbatical options.

Exciting Playground: Dive into different industries, apps and digital solutions with plenty of creative freedom.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: An experienced crew in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears - from designs to business ideas or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to understand who you are - and help you understand us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

1 Business Development Manager (m/f/d) - Partnership & Growth (Mid-Level) Tasks
As a Business Development Manager - Partnerships & Growth at Trinsik, you drive partner acquisition for a global leading digital loyalty platform. Your core mission is targeting, reaching out to, and securing high-value brands to bring valuable offers into our loyalty ecosystem.

You manage the outreach pipeline end-to-end - from initial contact to signed partnership - and are measured on conversion. Our job is to build groundbreaking rewards platforms. Your job is to bring top-tier brand partners on board.

What You'll Do
º Own B2B partner and customer acquisition end-to-end for client projects - from target identification to closed deal

º Understand the value proposition of new or existing products fast, and translate it into sharp, conversion-focused outreach

º Build and manage the pipeline: prospecting, outreach sequencing, follow-up, qualification and closing

º Track, report and optimize the funnel - response rates, conversion, pipeline health - and react to the data

º Represent our clients' ventures and brands credibly to partners and decision-makers, often at senior level

º Test, learn and iterate on messaging, channels and targeting to lift conversion

Requirements
º A proven track record in (B2B) outreach, business development, sales or partnerships - you've built pipeline and closed deals

º The ability to understand a new offering fast and articulate its value convincingly

º A sales-, conversion- and success-driven mindset: you measure yourself on outcomes, not activity

º End-to-end ownership: comfortable running the full acquisition process independently, with structure and discipline

º Excellent communication and negotiation skills, written and verbal, in German and English

º Confident with CRM / pipeline tools and a data-informed approach to tracking and optimization

º A growth mindset: curious, self-driven, and comfortable being challenged

Nice to have
º Experience in high-profile brand acquisition or strategic partnerships

º Background in venture building, startups, or agency/consulting environments

º Familiarity with AI tools for outreach, research and pipeline automation

Benefits
The Numbers: €50,000 - €60,000 gross annually (positioned according to your competencies)

Daily Perk: your choice: a public transport subsidy or a tax-free daily lunch allowance.

Permanent discounts with 600+ top brands via our Corporate Benefits platform.

Flexibility & Trust: Flexible working hours and home office to balance your life, while keeping a vibrant team dynamic in our offices.

Change of Scenery: Work remotely from anywhere within the EU (up to 20 calendar days/year) or take advantage of our sabbatical options.

Latest Software: We work with what's current. If you know something newer and better, let's test it.

International Team: A well-established, experienced crew located in Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.

Flat Hierarchies: Your input finds open ears-whether it's about designs, business ideas, or party plans.

Feedback Culture: open, and direct.

Cool Workplace: Collaboration happens right in the middle of Vienna.

In a nutshell
Position: Full Time 

Entry Level: Mid-Level

Location: Vienna

Application process
We run a 3-stage process to get a clear picture of who you are - and to give you a clear picture of us. We position the role based on competencies, not titles.

1st Stage
Chemistry Check & Initial Technical Exchange: 30 min, virtual, with Maria (Head of People)

2nd Stage
Technical Skills: 60min in person, with two of our colleagues

3rd Stage
30 min virtual with Manuel (Partner)

Chie... 1 Supply Chain & Logistics Specialist (all genders) This position is located in the CEE Hub business area, which is based in Vienna. In this function you will be working closely for Austria, our CEE region (Bulgaria, Romania, Hungary, Slovenia, Slovakia and Czechia) and our MCO countries. We are looking for a highly motivated expert for whom team orientation and excellent communication skills are a part of everyday life.

You will be responsible for
 * Coordinate and organize temperature-controlled international transports in compliance with specified GDP quality guidelines for CEE, Baltic States, Balkan area, CIS countries, and Mongolia from the Vienna headquarters
 * Collaborate with the Head of SC&L to reconcile product quantities for transports
 * Manage and support the demand planning, replenishment for selected countries; facilitate supply review meeting to align with several stakeholder (countries, HUB, Headquarters)
 * Take responsibility for the demand and stock coverage, including mitigation actions preventing the disruptions in supply such as out of stock, batch recall
 * Generate, manage, and maintain all transport-related documentation, including customs and export paperwork
 * Process and post outgoing invoices and credit notes continuously for customers in the CEE, Balkan and Baltics region
 * Verify open incoming invoices from suppliers and transport companies
 * Coordinate logistical processes across relevant departments (FI/CO, REG)
 * Dispatch APIs (Working standards; Samples; Dangerous goods) in partnership with Pharmaceuticals Affairs
 * Perform monthly consignment stock closures (invoicing and stock level monitoring)
 * Oversee the annual inventory at the external warehouse

You will need to have
 * Hold a completed Commercial/Business education
 * Ideally possess professional experience in logistics or export in a pharmaceutical company
 * Proficient in MS Office applications (Excel, Word; IBP); SAP knowledge is advantageous
 * Have a strong numerical aptitude and demonstrate precise, independent work habits
 * Exhibit excellent written and verbal skills in both English and German
 * Possess a high level of reliability and customer service orientation
 * Thrive in a collaborative team environment that values uniquness and inclusion

Location
Vienna, Austria

No matter where your path starts at Chiesi, it leads to inspiring possibilities. Your future is our focus, and we are committed to nurturing your development in our dynamic, friendly environment with access to resources and training every step of the way.

We provide top-class benefits, including comprehensive healthcare programs and work-life balance initiatives. Our salary package is competitive, comprising a basic salary, performance bonuses, and benefits benchmarked against the external market. Additionally, we offer flexible working arrangements and remote work options. 

For this position, we offer a gross annual salary starting at EUR 53,000. We are committed to fair and competitive compensation, and are willing to offer a higher salary depending on qualifications and professional experience.

Chiesi is an equal opportunity employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce at all levels of our business. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment based on attitude and merit, without regard to race, national origin, age, sex, religion, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, military status, gender identity or expression, or any other basis protected by applicable laws. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, transfer, promotion, compensation, eligibility for benefits, and termination.
